hook: They invented a whole new way of bowling to stop one man. It didn't work.
story: The man was Donald Bradman, an Australian who learned cricket alone, hitting a golf ball with a single stump against a water tank. A batting average is the runs you score for each time you're out; above 50 is all-time great. By 1930, Bradman was scoring 974 runs in a single series. England's answer was Bodyline: fast balls aimed at his body. It sparked a diplomatic crisis between the two governments. Bradman still averaged 56.
number: Cricket eventually changed its laws because of him: direct attack bowling was outlawed. Nothing worked. He retired at 99.94, while the best completed career apart from his ended at 61.87. One statistician did the math: for Michael Jordan to dominate like this, he'd have needed 43 points a game. Jordan retired at 30.
closer: In Australia, the national broadcaster's post office box, in every capital city, is 9994. Coincidence?
full_text: They invented a whole new way of bowling to stop one man. It didn't work. The man was Donald Bradman, an Australian who learned cricket alone, hitting a golf ball with a single stump against a water tank. A batting average is the runs you score for each time you're out; above 50 is all-time great. By 1930, Bradman was scoring 974 runs in a single series. England's answer was Bodyline: fast balls aimed at his body. It sparked a diplomatic crisis between the two governments. Bradman still averaged 56. Cricket eventually changed its laws because of him: direct attack bowling was outlawed. Nothing worked. He retired at 99.94, while the best completed career apart from his ended at 61.87. One statistician did the math: for Michael Jordan to dominate like this, he'd have needed 43 points a game. Jordan retired at 30. In Australia, the national broadcaster's post office box, in every capital city, is 9994. Coincidence?
hook_alternatives: They invented a whole new way of bowling to stop one man. It didn't work.
They invented a new way of bowling just to stop one man. It barely worked.
He needed four runs in his final innings to average 100. He scored zero.
